newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ debt market ends weaker in line with U.S..
newsitem.headline: NZ debt market ends weaker in line with U.S..

text.p: Figures in brackets compare against previous day's close
* NZ debt market ends weaker in line with U.S.
* Yields steady throughout session after rising at open
* More players on deck next week but market seen quiet
The New Zealand debt market ended weaker on Friday in line with the United States, with bonds trading steady throughout the day after backing up 15 points at the open.
"The bond market basically followed the States...It was a reasonable performance really, given the States' performance," a bond dealer said.
The money market sold off a handful of points in sympathy with bonds, but the New Zealand dollar Trade-Weighted Index remained strong in a quiet forex market.

More traders will return to their desks next week but the market is expected to remain quiet until closer to the release of December quarter inflation data on January 17. --------------------------(SPREADS)-----------------------------
